title: 第19章 天帝降临道一圣地九头狮洒血护李若雪第20章 天帝的杀意与怒火道一圣地危
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
恬不知耻的血魔。
让圣地老祖们尽皆无言。
别人收徒，那是为了培养传承。
血魔收徒，那是为了培养血食，以便吃的更好！
就这血魔还想指点仙人身边的人？
血魔分明就是想分上奇药奇法等一杯羹！
“你就算了，长的太磕碜，别再吓坏若雪了。”
陈长生瞥了血魔一眼。
长的太磕碜！
这个拒绝它的借口，简直太诛它的心了！
血魔想哭了都。
“走了。”
陈长生与道一圣主等人告别。
让牛头马面在前方带路，带着血魔离开此地。
他们前往阴曹地府！
道一圣主等人则是返回道一圣地。
……
与此同时。
道一圣地外。
虚空涌动，光华冲霄。

一位中年男子带着一名五、六岁的男童，从虚空中走了出来。
“这里是除了超古道统外，最好的修行圣地。”
中年男子笑着对男童说道：“你先在这里修行，等你长大几岁后，再想办法将你送进超古道统内修行。”
“好！”
男童绚烂一笑，露出洁白闪亮的牙齿，看起来很是纯真可爱。
中年男子带着男童，来到道一圣地山门前上空。
“道一圣主出来拜见！”
中年男子立于云端，俯视道一圣地，神色淡漠。
他俨然不简单。
其声如雷，响彻整个道一圣地。
并且。
他说的是让道一圣主出来拜见。
而非说的前来拜见道一圣主！
他明显没把道一圣主放在眼中，姿态甚高。
道一圣地内上下巨震。
这道声音中带有的威压太恐怖。
content_en:
Shameless blood demon.
Let the ancestors of the Holy Land be speechless.
When others accept disciples, it is to cultivate inheritance.
The blood demon recruits disciples in order to cultivate blood food so that he can eat better!
This blood demon still wants to give advice to the people around the immortal?
The Blood Demon clearly wants to get a piece of the pie with the wonderful medicines and magical methods!
"Forget it, you're too ugly, don't scare Ruoxue anymore."
Chen Changsheng glanced at the Blood Demon.
Too tall!
This excuse for rejecting it is simply too heartbreaking!
Blood Demon wanted to cry.
"Gone."
Chen Changsheng said goodbye to Holy Master Dao Yi and others.
Let the bull-headed horse-face lead the way and take the Blood Demon away from here.
They head to the underworld!
Holy Lord Dao Yi and others returned to Dao Yi Holy Land.
……
at the same time.
Outside Tao Yi Holy Land.
The void surges, and brilliance soars into the sky.
A middle-aged man walked out of the void with a five or six-year-old boy.
"This is the best holy land for spiritual practice besides the ultra-ancient Taoism."
The middle-aged man smiled and said to the boy: "You practice here first, and when you grow up a few years, we will find a way to send you to practice in the super ancient Taoist tradition."
"Okay!"
The boy smiled brightly, showing his white and shining teeth. He looked very innocent and cute.
The middle-aged man took the boy to the sky in front of the mountain gate of Daoyi Holy Land.
"Holy Lord Daoyi comes out to pay homage!"
The middle-aged man stood on the clouds, looking down at Daoyi Holy Land with an indifferent expression.
He seems to be anything but simple.
Its sound was like thunder, resounding throughout the entire Dao Yi Holy Land.
and.
What he said was to let Holy Master Daoyi come out to pay his respects.
Instead of coming to see the Holy Lord Daoyi!
He obviously didn't take Holy Master Daoyi seriously, and his attitude was very high.
There was a huge earthquake in Daoyi Holy Land.
The coercion in this voice was too terrifying.
